info.description: Get a list of patches and their details for the given review
info.title: Crucible

requests.description:
Get the user authentication token.
 
 This is a legacy version of the login request. Using GET is deprecated as your password is likely to appear in logs which record request URLs.
 Use the POST version instead.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/auth-v1/login

requests.description: Get the user authentication token.
requests.name: POST /rest-service/auth-v1/login

requests.description: Get the list of projects that the authenticated user is entitled to access.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/projects-v1

requests.description: Returns a project description.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/projects-v1/{key}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a list of all repositories. This includes plugin provided repositories
requests.name: GET /rest-service/repositories-v1

requests.description: Lists the contents of the specified directory.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/repositories-v1/browse/{repository}/{path}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: GET /rest-service/repositories-v1/changes/{repository}/{path}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Returns the raw content of the specified file revision as a binary
 stream. No attempt is made to identify the content type and no mime
 type is provided.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/repositories-v1/content/{repository}/{revision}/{path}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Represents the history of a versioned entity.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/repositories-v1/history/{repository}/{revision}/{path}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Retrieves all reviews that are in one of the the specified states. For each review all details are included (review items + comments). The
 wiki rendered comments will be available via the <messageAsHtml> element
requests.name: GET /rest-service/reviews-v1/details

requests.description: To ignore a property, omit it from the query string.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/reviews-v1/filter

requests.description:
This method should no longer be used, as it uses a POST for a read-only
 retrieval operation and is provided for backward compatibility only.
requests.name: POST /rest-service/reviews-v1/filter

requests.name: GET /rest-service/reviews-v1/filter/details

requests.description:
This method should no longer be used, as it uses a POST for a read-only
 retrieval operation and is provided for backward compatibility only.
requests.name: POST /rest-service/reviews-v1/filter/details

requests.description: Get all the reviews which match the given filter, for the current user.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/reviews-v1/filter/{filter}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets a list of all the reviews that match the specified filter criteria.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/reviews-v1/filter/{filter}/details
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get comment metrics metadata for the specified metrics version.

requests.description: Returns Crucible version information.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/reviews-v1/versionInfo

requests.description:
Permanently deletes the specified review.
 The review must have been abandoned.
requests.name: DELETE /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Get a single review by its permId (e.g. "CR-45").
 If the review does not exist, a 404 is returned.
 
 The moderator element may not exist if the review does not have a Moderator.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Get a list of the actions which the current user is allowed to perform
 on the review.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}/actions
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
For the effective user, mark all comments in a review as read (except
 those marked as leave unread).
requests.name: POST /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}/comments/markAllAsRead
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes the given comment.
requests.name: DELETE /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}/comments/{cId}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the given comment.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}/comments/{cId}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the comment given by the perma id to the new comment posted.
requests.name: POST /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}/comments/{cId}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Marks the comment as leave unread to the current user - it will not automatically be marked as read by crucible.
requests.name: POST /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}/comments/{cId}/markAsLeaveUnread
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Mark the given comment as read for the user used to make this POST.
requests.name: POST /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}/comments/{cId}/markAsRead

requests.description: Gets the replies to the given comment.
requests.name: GET /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}/comments/{cId}/replies
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Adds a reply to the given comment. This call includes the  repsonse header that
 contains the URL of the newly created entity.
requests.name: POST /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}/comments/{cId}/replies
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes the reply.
requests.name: DELETE /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}/comments/{cId}/replies/{rId}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates a reply with the given newComment.
requests.name: POST /rest-service/reviews-v1/{id}/comments/{cId}/replies/{rId}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
